description: This file defines the class 'StartedKamonTimer' which implements the 'StartedTimer' interface, providing timer functionalities with segment handling, tagging, starting/stopping timing, and onStop handlers, specifically utilizing the Kamon library for metrics.

classes.name: StartedKamonTimer
classes.description: Implementation of a timer that uses Kamon for metrics, supporting tags, segments, start/stop, and onStop handlers.

methods.name: fromPreparedTimer
methods.description: Creates a new StartedKamonTimer instance from a PreparedTimer.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns a copy of all tags.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds or updates a single tag.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and returns a StoppedTimer instance.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the timer is still running.

methods.name: startNewSegment
methods.description: Starts a new segment timer with the given name.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Registers an OnStopHandler to be invoked when the timer stops.

methods.name: verifyRunning
methods.description: Ensures that the timer is currently running; throws exception if not.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the timer.

methods.name: getStartTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the timer was started.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Returns a copy of the map of segment timers.

methods.name: getOnStopHandlers
methods.description: Returns a list of registered onStop handlers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the timer object.
